title: Your EV Secretly Heats Its Battery Before Charging 🔥🔋 #shorts

scenes.text: Your EV may secretly heat its battery on the way to a fast charger. Why?
In the cold, lithium ions move slower, and resistance inside each cell rises.
Force fast-charging current into a cold cell, and lithium can plate onto the anode as metal, wearing the battery out.
So the car cuts charging power. In an Idaho National Lab study, at freezing, cars gained about a third less charge in the same time.
The fix: choose a fast charger in the navigation. Many EVs then warm the pack on the way, to around seventy to eighty-five degrees.
Allow about twenty to thirty minutes.
What else is your car doing quietly? Follow EV Drive.
